we designed and simulated a radiation-hardened phase- locked loop that does not cause single-event transient upsets upon ion irradiation.
a 200 MHz PLL fabricated using 0.18 µm SOI-CM OS technology is radiation-hardened against SETs with LET up to 50 MeV· cm2/mg at a 75% area penalty.

we designed a radiation-hardened phase- locked loop (PLL) using 0.20 µm SOI-CMOC technology and that we achieved a 200 MHz PLL that does not experience a single-event transient (SEI) upset upon ion irradiations with a linear energy loss (LET) of SO MeV-cm/mg.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, simulation and fabrication of a radiation-hardened 200 MHz PLL using 200 nm fully depleted SOI-CM
the development of radiation-hardened PLLs for use in space.
the development of a radiation-hardened phase- locked loop for use in space applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of radiation-hardened circuits in 200 nm CMOS is possible and that the design of such circuits is feasible with the use of the design methodology described herein.
the proposed PLL design is radiation-tolerant and suitable for space application.
the radiation-hardened 0.2-μm SOI-CMOC PLL is suitable to be used in space applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 200 nm SOICMOS process can be used as the basis for the development of a radiation-hardened-by-design (RHBD) circuit.
a 0.2-µm SOI-PLL with a 75% areal penalty is radiation-hardened against 50 MeV cm2/mg LET ion radiation.
we successfully developed a 200 MHz SOI PLL that is hardened against ion radiation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SET immunity of the PLL can be enhanced without a penalty to the chip area.
the use of SOI-CMOCs can reduce the area penalty of radiation hardening by 50% compared with the conventional approach.

the radiation tolerance of a PLL can be improved by using a radiation-hardened voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) and a radiation-tolerant phase frequency detector (PFD) with a radiation-hardened charge-pump (CP).
